subject: Vendor security kickoff & SIG initiation - Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@novacorp.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor security kickoff & SIG initiation - Redwood Inference

Hi Ethan —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our call and next steps on the security front so your security/compliance team has what they need to move forward: 

1) We are ready to start the SIG/CAIQ process — attaching a short starter spreadsheet that maps the typical SIG questions to our existing artifacts (redwood_SIG_start.xlsx).
2) SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in Q4 2025. I attached a one-page summary (SOC2-summary.pdf) and can share the full report under NDA if needed.
3) Data residency & GDPR: Hosted customers can choose region (us-east/us-west/eu-west). We offer Data Processing Addendum (DPA) language and standard SCCs.
4) HIPAA: We support HIPAA-covered workflows via our Private deployment; we offer a BAA for qualifying customers.

Clarifying questions for your team (so we can pre-populate the SIG/CAIQ and reduce back-and-forth):
- Which questionnaire format would you prefer (SIG, CAIQ, or your custom Word doc)?
- Do you need a list of subprocessors and their regions?
- Any mandatory encryption-at-rest KMs or in-house HSM requirement?
- Is there an expected procurement timeline / decision date?

Proposed next steps: I can send our security lead (Neha Kapoor) to a 30-min call with your InfoSec team this week to walk through any high-priority controls. Also happy to complete your vendor doc if you share it — attaching a blank starter SIG that maps our standard artifacts.

Attachments: redwood_SIG_start.xlsx, SOC2-summary.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

> -Ethan

From: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@novacorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor security kickoff & SIG initiation - Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the attachments. We received SOC2-summary.pdf and the SIG starter — appreciate the quick turnaround.

I attached our vendor questionnaire (NovaCorp_Vendor_Questionnaire.docx). A couple of high-level questions from our security team:
- Confirm SOC 2 Type II coverage period and the auditor name?
- Does Redwood use customer-provided KMS or only cloud-managed keys? We have a preference for customer-managed keys for some PII workloads.
- Any FedRAMP or IL5 posture?

We're aiming to complete vendor intake by March 12th. If you can populate our questionnaire, that would speed things up. Also, can we schedule the 30-min security call on Tue/Wed next week (open windows 10–12 PST)?

Attachments: NovaCorp_Vendor_Questionnaire.docx

—
Ethan Brooks
Director, IT Security | NovaCorp
ethan.brooks@novacorp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@novacorp.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor security kickoff & SIG initiation - Redwood Inference

Ethan —

Thanks — copying Neha (Head of Security) and Markus (SE) to help triage the questionnaire and confirm details. Quick answers inline, and then a proposed plan to reduce back-and-forth: 

Inline answers (short):
- SOC 2: Type II report covers 2025-09-01 to 2025-12-31; auditor: Clearwater Audit LLP. We can provide the full report under NDA.
- KMS: By default we use cloud-managed keys (AWS KMS / GCP KMS). For Dedicated and Private deployments we support customer-managed keys (bring your own key via KMS/HSM integrations).
- FedRAMP/IL5: Not currently certified; we provide compliance guidance for regulated customers and private deployment options for higher assurance needs.

Proposed plan to accelerate: 
1) We will pre-fill the high-level administrative fields in your questionnaire (owner, contact, SOC dates, subprocessor list link).
2) Neha can join a 30-min walkthrough with your team on Wed 18 Feb at 10:30 PST to answer control-level questions. If that works, I will calendar-invite.
3) We will attach a spreadsheet mapping NovaCorp's questionnaire items to our SIG/CAIQ artifacts (so you have evidence pointers).

Open items for your team:
- Please confirm whether you need BAA/HIPAA-specific attestations for this engagement.
- Is there a preferred delivery method for the full SOC 2 report (SFTP, secure ShareFile, or NDA + DocuSign)?

I've attached an internal checklist and will start populating your Word doc once we confirm the call.

Attachments: (internal checklist) redwood_SIG_start.xlsx

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Marissa —

Wed 18 Feb 10:30 PST is confirmed for the walkthrough — I'll forward a calendar invite with our InfoSec and procurement team. A few quick notes ahead of the call:
- Procurement asked about typical commercial lead times; they're budgeting for a March 15 target for contract signature.
- We do require a DPA and would like a standard BAA if HIPAA scope is triggered.
- I attached the completed questionnaire with a few redlines/questions highlighted (NovaCorp_questionnaire_filled.docx).

If you can have Neha ready to cover encryption/subprocessor details and Markus to speak to deployment options, that should get us what we need on the call.
